kultivator.hidup.seru.umum.0: Come, come! Good wares, honest prices!
kultivator.hidup.seru.umum.1: Stop a moment, young master, just have a look!
kultivator.hidup.seru.umum.2: Cheap today, who knows about tomorrow!
kultivator.hidup.seru.bankir.0: Leave your silver at the Money House and sleep soundly!
kultivator.hidup.seru.bankir.1: A draft from this house is honoured in every far town.
kultivator.hidup.seru.bankir.2: Small interest, iron vaults, guards day and night.
kultivator.hidup.seru.bandar_batu.0: One cut can change your fate!
kultivator.hidup.seru.bandar_batu.1: Raw stone from the spirit mines, who dares guess what is inside?
kultivator.hidup.seru.bandar_batu.2: Yesterday someone got green jade the size of a fist!
Fresh spirit feed, your beast will climb a tier in no time!
Look at that fur, sir, no ordinary beast!
kultivator.hidup.seru.pedagang_senjata.0: Spirit-iron swords, fresh from the furnace!
kultivator.hidup.seru.pedagang_senjata.1: Jian, dao, spears, all honed by a master smith!
kultivator.hidup.seru.pedagang_senjata.2: Hold it first, feel the balance!
kultivator.hidup.seru.pemilik_penginapan: Clean rooms, warm tea, noodle soup until late!
Tired traveller? A soft bed is waiting!
We look after horses and mounts too!
kultivator.hidup.seru.penjaga_teka.0: Answer the riddle, win a lantern!
kultivator.hidup.seru.penjaga_teka.1: Three guesses, one prize, come and try!
kultivator.hidup.seru.penjaga_teka.2: Tonight's riddle is a hard one, do you dare?
Thread, needles, salt and news from town!
Goods from seven villages, cheap and cheerful!
I carried these a long way, won't you even look?
kultivator.hidup.seru.petugas_bea.0: Cargo off the sea reports here first!
kultivator.hidup.seru.petugas_bea.1: No customs seal, no crate leaves the dock!
kultivator.hidup.seru.petugas_bea.2: Ship's name, cargo, port of origin, all written down!
kultivator.hidup.seru.penjual_ikan.1: Sea prawns, clams, salted fish, cheap!
Spices from lands across the sea!
Gold-embroidered cloth, found in no other market!
Bargain if you like, but these are rare goods!
kultivator.hidup.seru.kafilah_bashi.0: The caravan leaves the day after tomorrow, there is room for cargo!
kultivator.hidup.seru.kafilah_bashi.1: Our camels are strong, our route is safe!
kultivator.hidup.seru.kafilah_bashi.2: Send your goods to the far oasis at half price!
kultivator.hidup.seru.pedagang_bazar.0: Sweet dates, woven carpets, copper lanterns!
kultivator.hidup.seru.pedagang_bazar.1: Come in, come in, free mint tea for those who look!
kultivator.hidup.seru.pedagang_bazar.2: The first price is always the highest, come haggle!
kultivator.hidup.seru.nyonya_sutra.0: Cloud silk, three months on the loom.
kultivator.hidup.seru.nyonya_sutra.1: This colour suits only people of standing.
kultivator.hidup.seru.nyonya_sutra.2: Touch it, miss, smooth as pond water.
kultivator.hidup.seru.makelar_gelap.0: Psst, looking for something the ordinary market does not sell?
kultivator.hidup.seru.makelar_gelap.1: The goods are here, just don't ask where they came from.
kultivator.hidup.seru.makelar_gelap.2: Pay in spirit stones, no records.
kultivator.hidup.seru.pedagang_pil.2: Tell me your realm and I'll pick the right pill.
kultivator.hidup.seru.juru_lelang.0: The auction opens soon, ready your bids!
kultivator.hidup.seru.juru_lelang.1: Tonight's treasures are one of a kind!
kultivator.hidup.seru.pengemis.0: A little alms, sir, may the Dao bless you.
kultivator.hidup.seru.pengemis.1: Three days without a bowl of rice...
kultivator.hidup.seru.pengemis.2: A small kindness, a great merit, young master.
kultivator.hidup.seru.biksu_gunung.0: Offer incense and calm your heart.
kultivator.hidup.seru.biksu_gunung.1: The path to the summit is long, rest a while at the monastery.
kultivator.hidup.seru.biksu_gunung.2: Amitabha. May your journey be safe.
kultivator.hidup.seru.pendeta_laut.0: Ask the Sea Goddess's blessing before you sail!
kultivator.hidup.seru.pendeta_laut.1: Prayer lanterns for the sailors not yet home.
kultivator.hidup.seru.pendeta_laut.2: The sea is calm for those who honour it.
kultivator.hidup.sapa.nama.1: %s! This town is always glad to see you.
kultivator.hidup.sapa.nama.2: Greetings, %s, may your road be wide today.
kultivator.hidup.marah.0: Hmph, the nerve of that one, coming back here.
kultivator.hidup.marah.1: That's the one... watch your belongings.
kultivator.hidup.marah.2: This town has not forgotten what you did.
kultivator.hidup.takut.2: Don't be angry, senior, we are only common folk.
kultivator.hidup.buronan.0: That's the wanted one! Guards, guards!
kultivator.hidup.buronan.1: That face is on the notice board! Call the guards!
kultivator.hidup.buronan.2: Seize them! The Yamen wants them!
kultivator.hidup.pencuri.2: Guards! They're taking what isn't theirs!
kultivator.hidup.tawar.beli.0: How much for this? Take a little off.
kultivator.hidup.tawar.beli.1: The stall next door was cheaper yesterday!
kultivator.hidup.tawar.beli.2: I'll take two if the price is fair.
kultivator.hidup.tawar.jual.0: All right, all right, this price just for you.
kultivator.hidup.tawar.jual.1: I lose on it, but you're a regular.
kultivator.hidup.uji.tanpa_tempat: No active inhabited place within 128 blocks.

kultivator.hidup.kegiatan.api_unggun: telling tales by the caravan fire
kultivator.hidup.kegiatan.ceramah: at the sermon in the hall
kultivator.hidup.kegiatan.dupa_kaki: burning incense at the Foot Temple
kultivator.hidup.kegiatan.hitung_malam: counting coins in the dead of night
kultivator.hidup.kegiatan.jaga_pesta: on guard at the Blood Feast
kultivator.hidup.kegiatan.kedai_racun: drinking poison cups at the tavern
kultivator.hidup.kegiatan.lift_berhenti: waiting out the storm at the station
kultivator.hidup.kegiatan.pasar_air: trading at the Morning Water Market
kultivator.hidup.kegiatan.pasar_bulan: trading at the Crescent Night Market
kultivator.hidup.kegiatan.pasar_gelap: whispering in the Market of a Thousand Shadows
kultivator.hidup.kegiatan.pasar_ikan: selling at the Morning Fish Market
kultivator.hidup.kegiatan.pulang_melaut: hauling nets back from the sea
kultivator.hidup.kegiatan.teropong: watching the sea through a spyglass
kultivator.hidup.kegiatan.tutup_hujan: closing the stall for the rain
kultivator.hidup.petir.anak.2: I'm not scared... only a little.
kultivator.hidup.petir.dewasa.0: That bolt struck near the market.
kultivator.hidup.petir.dewasa.2: Let's hope that's no cultivator's tribulation.
kultivator.hidup.uji.simpul: Street nodes: %s, bodies walking: %s, crowd watchers: %s
kultivator.hidup.uji.keadaan: %s is now %s (household %s); %s bodies re-read their schedule.
kultivator.hidup.uji.keadaan_sendiri: This resident lives alone: there is no household to mourn.
kultivator.hidup.keadaan.datang.0: Greetings, sir. I only moved into that house yesterday.
kultivator.hidup.keadaan.datang.1: Forgive me, I still don't know these streets.
kultivator.hidup.keadaan.datang.2: They say the old owner of this house was a good soul. I hope to carry on.
kultivator.hidup.keadaan.datang.3: What a lively town! Back in my village the market opened once a week.
kultivator.hidup.keadaan.pulih.0: Ouch... the wound hasn't quite closed. The physician says two more days.
kultivator.hidup.keadaan.pulih.1: Don't worry, sir. My bones are tough, I'll be working again soon.
kultivator.hidup.keadaan.pulih.2: The neighbours bring me porridge every morning. Good people here.
kultivator.hidup.keadaan.pulih.3: I've learned my lesson about walking alone when beasts are about.
kultivator.hidup.keadaan.duka.0: Forgive me, sir... our house is in mourning.
kultivator.hidup.keadaan.duka.1: They left us too soon. The incense for them hasn't burned out yet.
kultivator.hidup.keadaan.duka.2: Thank you for asking. We will be all right... in time.
kultivator.hidup.keadaan.duka.3: Tonight we light incense at the altar. May their spirit find peace.
kultivator.hidup.sapa.anak.0: Big sibling cultivator! Can you fly?
kultivator.hidup.sapa.anak.2: Mother says not to bother cultivators... hehe, hello!
kultivator.hidup.sapa.penjaga.0: Mind your manners in this town, traveller.
kultivator.hidup.sapa.penjaga.1: The streets are quiet today. Let's keep them so.
kultivator.hidup.sapa.penjaga.2: Any trouble? Report it at the guard post.
kultivator.hidup.sapa.pedagang.0: Stop by a moment, sir! Looking costs nothing.
kultivator.hidup.sapa.pedagang.1: For a new customer, a friend's price!
kultivator.hidup.sapa.pedagang.2: New stock came in this morning, still warm!
kultivator.hidup.sapa.tetua.0: Young one, your road is long. Don't rush it.
kultivator.hidup.sapa.tetua.1: May the heavens guard you on your way.
kultivator.hidup.sapa.tetua.2: When I was your age, this town was a patch of rice field.
kultivator.hidup.sapa.kultivator.0: A fellow walker of the path, my respects.
kultivator.hidup.sapa.kultivator.1: Your Qi is steady. Your training wasn't wasted.
kultivator.hidup.sapa.kultivator.2: If you have time, let's spar someday.
kultivator.hidup.sapa.iblis.0: Hm. Fresh meat in the Demon City.
kultivator.hidup.sapa.iblis.1: Watch your purse... and your life.
kultivator.hidup.sapa.iblis.2: Righteous folk rarely last long here.
kultivator.hidup.sapa.pagi.0: Good morning! The air is fresh, isn't it.
kultivator.hidup.sapa.pagi.2: A bright morning to start the day.
kultivator.hidup.sapa.siang.0: Good day. The sun bites, find some shade.
kultivator.hidup.sapa.siang.2: The day is long and the work is plenty.
kultivator.hidup.sapa.sore.0: Good evening. The lanterns will be lit soon.
kultivator.hidup.sapa.sore.2: An evening like this calls for hot tea.
kultivator.hidup.sapa.malam.0: Good night. Keep to the lit streets.
kultivator.hidup.sapa.malam.1: Evening, sir. It's getting late, you know.
kultivator.hidup.sapa.malam.2: A bright moon tonight. Sleep well later.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.musim_0.0: The rice seedlings can go in, the soil is so soft.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.musim_0.1: The peach blossoms by the river are opening too.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.musim_0.2: Spring always makes people want to marry, ha!
kultivator.hidup.obrol.musim_0.3: As long as it doesn't rain forever, or the seedlings rot.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.musim_1.0: So hot today even the paving stones are boiling.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.musim_1.1: The children ran off to the pond at dawn.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.musim_1.2: The fishermen are happy, the fish are plentiful.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.musim_1.3: As long as the well doesn't dry up, all is well.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.musim_2.0: A decent harvest this year. The granary is nearly full.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.musim_2.1: There's a Harvest Festival tonight, are you coming?
kultivator.hidup.obrol.musim_2.2: Of course! I've been saving for moon cakes.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.musim_2.3: Don't eat them all before I get there!
kultivator.hidup.obrol.musim_3.0: The cold cuts to the bone. Charcoal went up again.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.musim_3.1: Cultivators have it easy, their Qi keeps them warm.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.musim_3.2: Warm wine and a thick quilt will do for us.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.musim_3.3: Let's go to the tavern, the ginger porridge is steaming.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.kerja_pekerja.0: My back aches, orders have piled up since yesterday.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.kerja_pekerja.1: Same here. This hammer's had its handle replaced thrice.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.kerja_pekerja.2: But the pay covers meat on market day.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.kerja_pekerja.3: Honest work, sound sleep. My father's words.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.kerja_pedagang.0: My stall did well today, the salt was gone by noon.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.kerja_pedagang.1: Lucky you. I got haggled down to half price.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.kerja_pedagang.2: Ah, that must be the overseas trader. Stubborn lot.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.kerja_pedagang.3: Tomorrow I'll raise my price first, so I can come down.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.kerja_penjaga.0: Last night's watch was quiet, just stray cats.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.kerja_penjaga.1: Don't say that, or something real will show up.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.kerja_penjaga.2: The captain says a fugitive is loose on the east road.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.kerja_penjaga.3: Then I'll hone my spear again tonight.
I'm stuck: three months at the same stage.
Don't force it. Forced Qi turns back on the heart.
Master says I need to fight, not meditate.
Then tomorrow at dawn on the field. I won't go easy.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.kerja_cendekia.0: The book you borrowed yesterday has a torn page.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.kerja_cendekia.1: Not me! It's been like that since the last dynasty.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.kerja_cendekia.2: Ha, the classic excuse. Copy it out by your own hand.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.kerja_cendekia.3: Very well... ink and patience, a scholar's two treasures.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.kerja_tetua.0: My knees creaked again this morning. Rain's coming.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.kerja_tetua.1: Your knees beat the court astronomers.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.kerja_tetua.2: Once we climbed that cliff without losing our breath.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.kerja_tetua.3: Once. Now the house stairs are an achievement.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.kerja_pejabat.0: The southern district's tax report is late again.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.kerja_pejabat.1: Yesterday's rain broke the bridge, they ask for relief.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.kerja_pejabat.2: Note it. But send an inspector, words alone won't do.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.kerja_pejabat.3: As always, sir. Two copies for the archive.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.kerja_anak.1: No way, I was it yesterday!
kultivator.hidup.obrol.kerja_anak.2: Then let's spin tops. Mine is the fastest!
kultivator.hidup.obrol.kerja_anak.3: Prove it! The loser buys sugar candy.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.kerja_iblis.0: The enforcer collected double blood tax today.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.kerja_iblis.1: Not so loud. The walls here have ears.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.kerja_iblis.2: There's a new gladiator in the arena tonight, from a righteous sect they say.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.kerja_iblis.3: Poor thing. I bet he lasts three rounds.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.hari_pasar.0: Market day! The peddlers arrived at dawn.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.hari_pasar.1: I want needles and silk thread for my wife.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.hari_pasar.2: Haggle to half, they always double the price.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.hari_pasar.3: You say that, yet you bought three baskets yesterday!
kultivator.hidup.obrol.hari_libur.0: Rest day! Finally a whole day of fishing.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.hari_libur.1: I mean to sleep till the sun is high.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.hari_libur.2: Lazybones! Let's play chess under the banyan.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.hari_libur.3: Fine, but if you lose, the wine's on you.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.malam.0: It's late. The lanterns at the end of the street are going out.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.malam.1: They say ghosts cross the old bridge at midnight.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.malam.2: Bah, that's a tale to scare the children.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.malam.3: All the same, I'm going home by the main road.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.duka_tetangga.0: Did you hear? Our neighbour in the back lane... is gone.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.duka_tetangga.1: I heard. The family has burned incense since yesterday.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.duka_tetangga.2: This evening I'll take rice and candles to their house.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.duka_tetangga.3: I'll come along. That's what neighbours are for.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.pendatang.0: The empty house at the end of the street has someone in it now.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.pendatang.1: Yes, a newcomer. Just one bundle for luggage.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.pendatang.2: Seems polite. Let's give them a proper welcome.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.pendatang.3: I'll bring sesame cakes tomorrow morning.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.pulih_tetangga.0: The craftsman next door can walk again, though he limps.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.pulih_tetangga.1: Lucky the physician came quickly that time.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.pulih_tetangga.2: His arm's still in a sling, poor man can't work.
kultivator.hidup.obrol.pulih_tetangga.3: Let's carry his timber for him until he's healed.
